messages:
alex: Quick async standup — preflight for tomorrow's tilt.
alex: What I did: filed the spot-fallback ticket with cloud support (#CC-3124), adjusted autoscaler policy for eu-west lanes to reduce cold starts, and prepped a short runbook for the drain test.
alex: Blockers: quota increase for ap-southeast still pending — cloud support asked for justification, need a succinct CPU/GPU utilization snapshot.
alex: Today: will add utilization snapshot to the ticket and try to reserve 4 GPUs in ap-southeast for the 09:00 UTC prewarm. pinging @maria for quota ask wording.
maria: Got it — I can draft the justification. short version: 2x baseline traffic expected + canary traffic for model-x, includes SLA window. I'll attach the 24h utilization graph.
maria: I've also confirmed we can accept partial increase if full 4 nodes aren't available immediately.
jordan: FYI I patched the autoscaler policy — changed cooldown to 45s and lowered minReplica to 2 for canary lanes. Command I ran:
```
kubectl apply -f autoscaler-eu-canary.yaml
# autoscaler policy v2: cooldown=45s, min=2, max=20
```
jordan: I'll run a smoke test against the fallback routing after maria posts the partial quota confirmation.
sara: Heads-up: customer parallel tests run 08:30-09:30 UTC, so if we reserve 09:00 UTC we might see short contention. Can we shift to 09:15 to reduce overlap?
alex: Good call. I'll move the prewarm start to 09:15 and update the runbook.
provision-bot: [AUTO] Reservation request created: rsv-177601-01, region=ap-southeast-1, gpus=4 (status=pending). Link: https://infra.redwood/internal/reservations/rsv-177601-01 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: Cloud support replied — partial quota approved (2 GPUs) while they review. I updated ticket #CC-3124 with utilization and PR links.
jordan: Acknowledged. I'll proceed with canary at 09:15 using 2 GPUs, validate fallback behavior, then scale up if cloud support increases quota.
alex: Plan B: if quota doesn't increase by 09:00, we'll run a reduced-canary (2 gpus) and schedule a follow-on warm for 12:00 UTC when more capacity frees up.
alex: PR for the runbook and autoscaler change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/642 — please review and lgtm if ok.
maria: Reviewing now, will leave comments.
jordan: Smoke test scheduled 09:20 UTC — will post results here. :white_check_mark:
sara: Thanks team — I'll update the customer-facing timeline and ask them to shift to 09:30 if we still see contention.
alex: Thanks everyone. I'll close the loop after the 09:20 smoke and update the incident doc if anything odd shows up. :thumbsup:
